items.title: Relative Serre duality and relative full-twist centrality for finite Coxeter Hecke categories
items.author: Colton Sandvik
items.difficulty_reason: The categorical relative-duality result requires rigidity of Abe-Bott-Samelson bimodules, mixed-derived recollement, convolution action on kernel subcategories, parabolic linearity and a natural counit comparison, followed by canonical centrality through equivalences of generated subcategories. Original finite-Coxeter and realization/base-ring assumptions retained; the previous push/pull module-functor proposition is uncounted support. The two parts of the original main conjecture remain one collected object.

primary.label: complete original relative-duality theorem and centrality statement, jointly one author main conjecture

proof_spans.label: complete original kernel/support/counit preparation and both relative-duality and centrality proofs

contexts.label: original complete realization assumptions, Hecke/mixed-derived categories, rigidity, recollement, induction adjoints and relative full-twist definitions
